idea-plugin.name: SpringLens - Spring Boot RESTful API Tester
idea-plugin.description:
SpringLens is a lightweight, zero-configuration RESTful API testing client seamlessly integrated into IntelliJ IDEA. Designed specifically for Spring Boot and Spring Cloud developers, it allows you to test, debug, and manage APIs directly within your IDE without switching between external tools.

Key Features

  • Deep AST/PSI Endpoint Scanner: Automatically discovers and indexes all @RestController endpoints across all project modules in real-time.
  • Instant DTO Schema Sync: Generates mock JSON request bodies directly from Java DTO classes, POJOs, and Records with recursive reference protection.
  • Spring Cloud Gateway Support: Automatically resolves Gateway routing rules (StripPrefix, PrefixPath, RewritePath) and microservice context paths.
  • Global Authentication Sharing: Configure Bearer JWT tokens or custom auth headers once and sync them across all endpoints with a single click.
  • Custom Collections & Requests: Create manual requests and custom folders alongside scanned project endpoints for external API testing.
  • Dev-Friendly SSL: Built-in Trust-All SSL handler for local microservices running on self-signed HTTPS certificates.
  • Workspace Persistence: Automatically saves query parameters, headers, and request payloads per project across IDE restarts.
  • Instant cURL Export: Copy formatted cURL commands instantly for terminal execution and team collaboration.

Compatibility

• Spring Framework: 5.x, 6.x
• Spring Boot: 2.x, 3.x
• Spring Cloud: Gateway, Eureka, Consul
• Languages: Java 17+, Kotlin | Build Tools: Maven, Gradle

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.2 — Security, Reliability & Request Handling

  • Safer Workspace Persistence: Protected credentials and sensitive request/response data, added collision-safe schema migration, and prevented orphan pruning after empty scans.
  • Hardened HTTP Client: Added per-project sessions and cookies, bounded response storage and downloads, fixed asynchronous response races, and enforced explicit consent for insecure local TLS.
  • More Accurate Requests & Exports: Preserved repeated query parameters and multi-value headers, improved URL resolution, strengthened cURL/PowerShell/CMD quoting, and added multipart file validation.
  • Deterministic Spring Configuration: Improved multi-module, multi-profile, placeholder, context-path, and Gateway route resolution.

1.1.1 — Microservices & Security Scanner Improvements

  • Gateway Performance & URL Sync: Cached Gateway configuration in memory to eliminate UI freezes on endpoint navigation and resolved single-URL fixation in Gateway mode.
  • Constant & Variable Array Resolution: Upgraded static AST scanner to recursively resolve variables, constant arrays (e.g. PUBLIC_ENDPOINTS), and List.of(...) in Spring Security permitAll() definitions.
  • IntelliJ 2025.2+ Threading Compatibility: Fixed background indexing assertion errors and added automatic scanning on project indexing completion.
  • Flexible Microservice Route Matching: Case-insensitive matching for microservice route IDs, prefixes, and lb:// URIs.

1.1.0 — Security Badges & Cache Management

  • Interactive Security Lock Badges: Visual lock/unlock toggle indicators for endpoint authentication requirements.
  • Response History & Persistence: Preserves latest response metrics and payload snapshots across IDE sessions.
  • Global Cache Reset: One-click Clear Cache utility for stored endpoints and workspace history.
